Poppler optional Windows payload
================================

MCP-PDF can invoke the separately distributed pdftoppm executable from Poppler
for optional PDF page rendering. Poppler is not linked into McpPdf.exe.

Project: https://poppler.freedesktop.org/
Source:  https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/poppler/poppler
License: GNU General Public License, version 2 or later (GPL-2.0-or-later)

The Windows payload staged by scripts/build-installer.ps1 must come from a
reviewed, version-pinned distribution. Before production redistribution, retain
that distribution's complete license and third-party notice files and satisfy
the applicable source-code availability obligations. This notice is not a
replacement for those files or for legal review.
